def isCarmichael (n : Nat) : Bool :=
  n ≥ 2 && (∀ p ∈ n.factorization.support, p.Prime) &&
    (∀ p ∈ n.factorization.support, (n - 1) % (p - 1) = 0)

def countCarmichael (b : Nat) : Nat :=
  (List.range (b + 1)).filter isCarmichael |>.length

def check_l1 : Bool :=
  countCarmichael 10 = 0 &&
  countCarmichael 100 = 0 &&
  countCarmichael 1000 = 1 &&
  countCarmichael 10000 = 2 &&
  countCarmichael 100000 = 7 &&
  countCarmichael 1000000 = 16 &&
  countCarmichael 10000000 = 43 &&
  countCarmichael 100000000 = 255
